sections.note: Razorpay configuration per Phase2 8: two-column layout (API Credentials + Test Integration + Integration Features on the left, Connection Status + Supported Payment Methods + doc links on the right). Implemented as an anchor-scrolled section (#section-razorpay) of the shared Integrations page rather than a standalone route - Test/Live are two independently-configured real environments (existing feature) rather than the reference's single-form Test/Live radio, since forcing one editable form would remove the ability to see and edit both simultaneously.

responsive.note: Same shared-shell sidebar/topbar pattern as other authenticated pages; the scrolled-to section naturally scrolls the shared topbar out of view at this viewport height, which the flat reference mockup (a standalone page) does not need to account for.
